findings.summary: en.wikipedia.org robots.txt (read this Attempt) confirms /w/ and /wiki/Special: are disallowed while /wiki/<Title>?action=raw carries no rule — the disallow on the wired route is real and the raw-title route is the compliant substitute.

api.wikimedia.org robots.txt answered HTTP 200 with an HTML page rather than a robots document; permission is CANNOT_TELL and the host was not opened, so the provider's proposed REST-search next move remains unopenable this Attempt.

No Wikipedia biography exists for the subject: 'Daniel Keenan' redirects to 'Daniel F. Keenan', a Massachusetts state representative born 1961 in Holyoke — a different person from the AZ CD-5 2026 candidate; Wikipedia therefore yields no bio/photo/campaignSite for this subject via a person article.

The statewide race article's full wikitext (146,621 bytes) was fetched and vaulted; it carries per-district 2026 Arizona House candidate lists and is the remaining Wikipedia-side source for CD-5 enrichment.

nextRungs: Parse the vaulted artifact ar-00002aacaa324bf4bfdeb3f3 for the '==District 5==' section and confirm/deny a 'Keenan' entry.

If absent, walk open-data/official rungs for the owed fields: Arizona Secretary of State 2026 candidate portal (azsos.gov) and FEC candidate/committee API (api.open.fec.gov) for campaignSite and contact.
Re-read api.wikimedia.org/robots.txt on a later Attempt; if it serves a real robots document, add the REST search adapter as a discovery-only route.
